listing.name: Reverse Collapse: Codename Bakery Portraits Pack
listing.summary: A light portraits pack containing characters from MICA Team's Reverse Collapse: Codename Bakery, added mostly only for your player faction. Also includes 8 flags from factions you encounter throughout the story. Should be safe to download and drop right into your modpack.
listing.aiSummary: Adds character portraits and faction flags from Reverse Collapse: Codename Bakery.

description:
Reverse Collapse: Codename Bakery Portraits Pack

DOWNLOAD LINK [v1.0.1]

A light portraits pack containing characters from MICA Team's Reverse Collapse: Codename Bakery, added mostly only for your player faction.
Also includes 8 flags from factions you encounter throughout the story.
Should be safe to download and drop right into your modpack. No massive portraits count warning here, it's less than 100 items.

Portraits Preview

"Because it's Operation Bakery", or so they said.

Flags Preview

Included Contents
Base Pack & Flags
URNC Garrison - Mob Characters Pack

Portraits were sourced from the game's official artworks, and belongs to Sunborn / MICA Team.

Changelogs
(MM/DD/YY Format)
1.0.1 - 03/10/26 - Added Version Checking Support

1.0.0 - 02/25/26 - Initial Forums Release

Wait, you're saying they don't eat penguins down there?
